paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: loop a local video behind the chat UI, with play/pause, opacity, scrim and fit controls.
• DSH 插件：在对话背景循环播放本地视频，支持播放/暂停、不透明度、遮罩与填充。
# dsh-video-bg
> **真没想到你能做到这一步啊！领域展开——【无量空处】**
English | 中文

Loop a local video as the background of the DeepSeek Harness chat UI — on the
plain Web surface (`ds

h web`) and inside DSH Desktop, which renders the same web
app. The panels become translucent so the

video shows through, while chat
bubbles and the composer stay readable.
## Features

- **Background video**: a fixed, full-viewport `<video>` painted at `z-index: -1`
and streamed from

the host over HTTP, so a multi-hundred-MB file plays without
ever being uploaded. HTTP Range (`206`/

`416`) support lets the browser seek and
read ahead.
- **Translucent UI**: the shell's design tokens

(`--dsw-alias-bg-base`,
`--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill`, `--dsw-specific-input-major`, …) are remappe

d to
semi-transparent colors for both light and dark themes, so every surface that
uses a token beco

mes translucent automatically. Chat bubbles and the composer
keep near-opaque fills.
- **Floating co

ntrol** (top-right): play/pause, video opacity, dark scrim for
contrast, fit (`cover`/`contain`), an

d collapse. Choices persist in
`localStorage` (`dsh.videoBg.v3`); the video pauses when the window i

s hidden.
- **Clear failures**: a missing or unreadable file shows a warning badge and a
console dia

gnostic instead of silently doing nothing.
- **Local only**: video bytes never leave the machine. Th

e plugin registers two
loopback HTTP routes on the existing DSH web server; no external service, no

egisters two
loopback HTTP routes on the existing DSH web server; no external service, no
telemetry.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** (`engines.dsh` in `package.json`), Web or Desktop.
The bundle is valida

ted against the installed runtime before it loads.
- Node 20+ (the host half only uses `node:fs`, `n

ode:path`, `node:url`).
- A video file readable by the **host** process (not the browser). MP4/WebM/

MOV/
MKV/AVI/OGG/TS are recognized; anything else is served as `video/mp4`.
## Install
The package is a normal DSH bundle, so any of these work:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

You can also install it from the GUI's plugin manager (Plugins → install /
browse). Installing a bun

dle selects it in `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically —
do not add the row by hand.

**Desktop note:** with the shipped profile, a newly installed bundle is applied
live (the running co

mposition recomposes and the page receives the new client
entry). If your profile is startup-only, f
ully quit and restart DSH Desktop once.
## Configure the video
Resolution order for the file:
/background.mp4` (a small default clip).

Set `videoPath` in your profile's own patch layer
(`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `videoPath` and `fit` are read by the host; `opacity`/`veil` are only defaults
for a browser that

has no saved slider values yet (the control's own values win
afterwards).
- The row id is `ui-video-

bg`; changing the config hot-reloads the plugin when
HMR is enabled.
- Environment alternative: set
`DSH_VIDEO_BG_PATH` before starting DSH.
## Using it
The floating control at the top-right has:
| Control | Effect |

| ▶ / ⏸ | Pause / resume the background video |
| 不透明度 / Opacity | Video opacity (0–100%), persisted

|
| 遮罩 / Scrim | Dark veil between video and UI (0–100%), persisted |
| 填充 / Fit | `cover` (fill th

e window) or `contain` (show the whole frame) |
| ▴ / ▾ | Collapse / expand the settings panel |

The badge next to the toggle reports buffering and file errors. A missing file is
also reported by `
GET /video-bg/status` and logged by the host.
## How it works

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`, exported from the package root) declares
`inject = ['webServer']` a

nd registers a prefix route:
- `GET/HEAD /video-bg/media` — streams the configured file with single-

range
support and a revision-based cache key (`?v=<size>-<mtime>`), so a changed
file is fetched aga

in instead of served from a stale media cache.
- `GET /video-bg/status` — JSON with `ok`, `rev`, `si

ze`, `mime`, the effective
path/source and the configured defaults.
- **Client half** (`lib/client.j

s`, exported as `./client`) is a lazy
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` bundle. `apply

(ctx)` mounts
everything inside `ctx.effect(...)`, so disabling the plugin or hot-replacing it
remov

es the attribute, styles, video, scrim and control.
- **Both surfaces**: the browser requests the ro

utes same-origin; DSH Desktop
serves the document from `dsh-app://app/` and forwards every other pat

h to the
same authenticated loopback host, so both work unchanged. All URLs in the
client are docume
nt-relative (`video-bg/media`), never absolute.
## Privacy and security

- The video is read by the host process and served **only** on the loopback web
server that DSH alre

ady runs for the GUI. Nothing is uploaded, and the plugin
makes no outbound requests.
- No credentia

ls, cookies, or environment values are read or exposed. The status
endpoint reveals the local path o

f the configured video, which the GUI already
shows in the control tooltip.
- `videoPath` is configu

ration, not user input: treat the profile patch as
trusted configuration, like any other DSH row con

on, not user input: treat the profile patch as
trusted configuration, like any other DSH row config.
## Compatibility and market metadata

- `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `ui-video-bg` row.
- `dsh.client.platform: "we

b"` + `exports["./client"]` → served by the client
module system.
- `engines.dsh` and `peerDependenc

ies` gate the bundle to the matching DSH
runtime; the host half imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package,

it only consumes the
injected `webServer` service.
- Display metadata lives in `locale/en.json` / `

locale/zh.json`, the icon in
`assets/icon.svg`, and the storefront screenshots in `screenshots.json`

.
- No build step is required, so GitHub installs need no `allowBuilds` approval.
